overview.description: The Pacer Barings CLO Market Flex ETF (AAAP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital preservation and current income through investments in collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) of any maturity that are rated BB or higher. The fund aims to maintain an average investment-grade rating of BBB- or above. AAAP was launched on Jun 22, 2026 and is issued by Pacer.
